transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... my supervisor told me I had to come. I guess... I keep leaving my station at work. Like, popping up during the safety meetings when we're supposed to be sitting down. She said it's a safety problem because I just... take off before I even think about it.
Have you been feeling unusually high or overly energetic lately?
Um... no. Not really. I just feel normal, I guess. Not... high or anything.
Did you have trouble sitting still as a child?

Yeah... I guess. Even back in elementary school, I couldn't really stay in my seat. I'd get... notes sent home a lot. Just for, like, wandering around the room or blurting stuff out. Talking over the teacher... stuff like that.
Before you get up and leave your station, do you usually feel a strong urge building that you just have to act on?

I don't know if it's an urge, exactly. It's just... when I have to stand by the machine, or sit through those trainings... it feels like this pressure building up inside me. Like my body just has to move. So I end up pacing, or stretching, or just... finding something else to do right then. I can't just stand there.
Does this happen in other places too, like at home or in other situations, where you feel like you just have to get up or move?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really noticed. At home I just... I don't know, I just do my own thing, I guess. I don't really think about it.
Do you often argue with people in charge when they tell you what to do?
No, not really. I mean... I just do what I'm supposed to do, mostly. I don't really get into it with the supervisors or anything.
Do you often have trouble paying attention or staying focused on tasks?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like... if I have to do the inventory logs, or read those CNC training pages. I start out really trying, but... after a few minutes, the numbers and words just kind of blur together. I have to keep going back over it... 'cause I realize I didn't actually take any of it in. So... yeah.
When you get up and leave your station, does doing it feel good or relieving in the moment?
Um... I guess so? I don't know, it's just... I just do it. I haven't really thought about if it feels good or whatever.
